objective.text: Invalidate or publish cache changes after commit so a rolled-back write does not become cached truth.

difficulty.rationale: Avoid publishing a new value that a rolled-back database write never committed.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The requirement is to avoid publishing rolled-back values; perfect consistency with all concurrent readers is a separate concern.

stem: A transaction changes a product price and updates its cache before a later statement fails. The cache now shows a price absent from the database. Which placement avoids that failure path?

options.text: Schedule the cache publication in DB::afterCommit.
options.rationale: An after-commit callback is discarded on rollback, so this failed transaction cannot publish its uncommitted value.

options.text: Keep the cache write inside the closure and increase the transaction retry count.
options.rationale: The cache is not transactionally rolled back merely because the database closure may retry.
options.misconception: The cache is not transactionally rolled back merely because the database closure may retry.

options.text: Write the cache before beginning the database transaction.
options.rationale: That publishes the new value even earlier and still survives a database rollback.
options.misconception: That publishes the new value even earlier and still survives a database rollback.

options.text: Publish in finally so every exit updates the cache.
options.rationale: finally also runs on failure and would publish the rolled-back value.
options.misconception: finally also runs on failure and would publish the rolled-back value.
